metaTitle: Custom Kids Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom kids lanyards and badges for schools, camps, and events. Durable, colorful, and safe for children. Order bulk at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom kids lanyards and badges are designed with child safety and durability in mind. Unlike standard lanyards, these feature breakaway clasps to prevent choking hazards and come in bright, kid-friendly colors like rainbow or neon. Whether you need them for school field trips, summer camp name tags, or youth group events, these lanyards hold up to daily wear. Decorate with full-color imprinting using your logo or fun designs. Choose from woven or printed options on soft polyester or nylon materials that are gentle on young skin.
heroAltText: Custom kids lanyards and badges with colorful designs and breakaway clasps for child safety.
